C1_REVIEW.evidence: Swapchain::Destroy performs a bounded event-query drain when gpuWorkSubmitted is true. After a successful drain, a transient live xrDestroySwapchain failure returns with gpuWorkSubmitted still true, causing the next retry to repeat an already-proven GPU completion wait despite no path submitting new swapchain graphics work between those destroy attempts.

evidence.spec_basis: OpenXR 1.1.63 requires all submitted graphics commands referring to a swapchain to complete before xrDestroySwapchain. The existing D3D11 event-query fence supplies that proof; once it succeeds, repeating the same fence without intervening GPU work is unnecessary.
code_review: WaitForSwapchainGpuIdleBeforeDestroy returning true is a completion proof for all earlier immediate-context commands.
No graphics command is submitted between that proof and xrDestroySwapchain.
On live destroy failure, handle/RTVs remain retained, while the next EnsureSwapchain retry can now skip only the already-satisfied drain.
